caption: The drawing depicts a detailed design of a woman's dress in shades of blue and black. The main dress features a full, floor-length skirt with vertical blue and black stripes, wider black stripes running from waist to hem, and horizontal bands of black near the bottom. Around the hem and above the lower black bands, there are intricate patterns resembling lace trim in black. The bodice of the dress includes a fitted jacket-like top with long sleeves, a blue lapel, and additional blue and black striped detailing. The neckline displays a pink, purple, and tan patterned section with decorative elements including thin horizontal bands in various colors. The dress is cinched at the waist with a black sash or belt. The drawing is composed on off-white paper, and in the upper right, there is a smaller, less detailed, monochromatic line drawing of the same dress design shown from the back. In the bottom right corner, the name "Marie Paullaro" and the date "June 16, 1938" are handwritten.
title: Dress
